# triton-sandbox (Python)

Python SDK for Triton sandboxes: Linux microVMs for agents and code.
The surface follows E2B, so moving over is mostly a change of import.

Not on PyPI yet. Install from git (the repository is private, so git needs
your GitHub credentials; `gh auth setup-git` sets that up):

```
pip install "git+https://github.com/TritonDataCenter/mariana-trench.git@main#subdirectory=sdks/python"
```

From a checkout: `pip install ./sdks/python`. Put a commit SHA in place of
the branch name to pin a version.

Python 3.10 or later. Dependencies: `httpx`, `websockets`.

## Quickstart, next to E2B

E2B:

```python
from e2b_code_interpreter import Sandbox          # E2B_API_KEY

sbx = Sandbox.create(timeout=300)
r = sbx.commands.run("echo hello")
print(r.stdout)
sbx.files.write("/tmp/a.txt", "data")
print(sbx.files.read("/tmp/a.txt"))
print(sbx.run_code("1 + 1").text)
print(sbx.get_host(3000))
sbx.kill()
```

Triton:

```python
from triton_sandbox import Sandbox                # TRITON_URL + TRITON_API_KEY

sbx = Sandbox.create(template="code-interpreter", timeout=300)
r = sbx.commands.run("echo hello")
print(r.stdout)
sbx.files.write("/tmp/a.txt", "data")
print(sbx.files.read("/tmp/a.txt"))
print(sbx.run_code("1 + 1").text)
with sbx.ports.forward(3000) as fwd:              # previews are coming; see Ports
    print(fwd.local_address)
sbx.kill()
```

`AsyncSandbox` has the same methods, each one awaited.

## Work on a GitHub repo

```python
import os
sbx = Sandbox.create(repo="acme/widget", branch="main", github_token=os.environ["GH_TOKEN"])
sbx.git("checkout", "-b", "fix")                    # runs in /work/widget
sbx.commands.run("make test", cwd="/work/widget")
sbx.git("commit", "-am", "Fix the bug")
sbx.git("push", "-u", "origin", "fix", github_token=os.environ["GH_TOKEN"])
```

Only github.com repos. The token goes only in the env of the git exec
(clone, fetch, push, ls-remote; run fetch then merge for a pull). It is not stored,
not written to the guest, and is scrubbed from errors. It is refused over
plain http, except to a loopback address. The SDK reads no token from the
environment. Egress to GitHub is added to the network policy.

## Credentials

Highest first:

1. Keyword arguments: `api_url`, `api_key`, `access_token`, `username` and `password`, `project`.
2. Environment: `TRITON_URL`, `TRITON_API_KEY`, `TRITON_ACCESS_TOKEN`,
   `TRITON_USERNAME` and `TRITON_PASSWORD`, `TRITON_PROJECT`.
3. The `tritonctl` session (`TRITONCTL_CONFIG_DIR`, else `~/.config/triton/tritonctl`).

A username and password log in at `/v1/auth/login` and refresh in memory.
The tritonctl session is read only: when its access token has expired, run
any `tritonctl` command to refresh it. The project is the one named, else
the tritonctl one, else the only project of the tenant.

A private CA goes in `TRITON_DC_ANCHORS` (added to the default roots, as
tritonctl does). `verify` or `TRITON_CA_CERT` names the only roots to trust.

## Surface

| Area | Calls |
|---|---|
| Lifecycle | `Sandbox.create(template=, timeout=, envs=, metadata=, labels=, package=, network=)`, `Sandbox.connect(id)`, `Sandbox.list(labels=)`, `Sandbox.kill(id)`, `sbx.kill()`, `set_timeout()`, `stop()`, `start()`, `pause()`, `resume()`, `snapshot()`, `fork(n)`, `resize(package)` |
| Processes | `sbx.commands.run(cmd, background=, on_stdout=, on_stderr=, envs=, cwd=, user=, timeout=, stdin=)`, `commands.connect/list/kill/send_stdin`, `CommandHandle.wait/kill/send_stdin` |
| Terminals | `sbx.pty.create(size=, on_data=)`, `pty.send_stdin/resize/kill` |
| Files | `sbx.files.read/write/list/stat/exists/remove/rename/make_dir/watch` |
| Ports | `ports.forward(port)` (local TCP listener over the tunnel), `ports.tunnel(port)`; preview URLs (`sbx.get_host(port)`, `sbx.ports.open(port, public=)`, `ports.list/close/url`) raise `PreviewsDisabledException` until the cloud has a preview domain |
| Code | `sbx.run_code(code, language=, context=)`, `create_code_context()` |
| Desktop | `sbx.desktop.screenshot/click/left_click/double_click/type/key/scroll/move/drag`, `rdp_tunnel()` |
| Other | `sbx.metrics()`, `get_metrics()`, `get_network()`, `set_network()`, `Sandbox.capabilities()` |

`cmd` is a shell line, or a list that runs without a shell. A non-zero exit
raises `CommandExitException` with the result.

## Errors

Every API refusal is a typed exception: `NotImplementedException` (with
`.reason`, for what this deployment leaves out on purpose),
`NotFoundException`, `RateLimitException` (with `.retry_after`),
`SandboxNotRunningException`, `PersistModeUnsupportedException`,
`QuotaExceededException`, `AuthenticationException`, and more, all under
`SandboxException`. `Sandbox.capabilities()` lists what the deployment does.

Differences from E2B that matter:

- Network egress is denied unless `network=` allows it.
- `files.remove()` refuses a non-empty directory unless `recursive=True`.
- `desktop.stream_url()` raises `NotImplementedException`; use `rdp_tunnel()`.
- File watches poll the events endpoint every 250 ms.

## Tests

```
pip install -e './sdks/python[dev]'
cd sdks/python && pytest
```

The tests run against `sdks/testing/mock_triton`, an in-memory API built on
the OpenAPI document. It checks every request and answer against the
schema, so drift from the contract fails the tests. No network is used.
